pages.text: The mouse buttons work the arms (and the shoulder weapons with them). $(k:key.headinajar.ability) fires the selected utility module (Ender Satchel, Smoke Mortar, Missile Pod, Workbench, Ore Scanner) and $(k:key.headinajar.secondary) picks the next. Sneak with them to fire the mecha's genes. Hold Sneak + $(k:key.headinajar.jar_menu) to eject.
